category_title: Young children with SEBD, communication difficulties, and short attention spans
minimal_context: The student is playing with toys alongside peers in a large mainstream classroom during break time.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is playtime in the big classroom, so go ahead and play with the toys with the other children.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t like it when we don’t play.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go find a group to play with.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The classroom has more toys and more colours, but I want more well-behaved peers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t like it when they hurt me and we argue.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is playtime in the big classroom, so go ahead and play with the toys with the other children.

STUDENT: I don’t like it when we don’t play.

TUTOR: Go find a group to play with.

STUDENT: The classroom has more toys and more colours, but I want more well-behaved peers.

TUTOR: Why do you say that?

STUDENT: I don’t like it when they hurt me and we argue.

task.content: Interacting with peers and practising the Golden Rules for behaviour
task.learning_goal: Understand and manage their feelings and build better relationships with their peers

context.environment: Bigger mainstream classroom or during break time

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Exposure to peer behaviour problems which may be more likely to occur in bigger mainstream classroom or during break time
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Suggested more well-behaved peers when asked what aspects they would change
